turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    B -->|Draft prompt| D[PROVIDE]

    subgraph ASSAY
        C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        C1 --> C2[Compress to residue]
        C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content]
        C3 --> C4[Find operative sentence]
        C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion, and flags]
        C5 --> C6["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE
        D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
        D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for mode]
        D2 --> D1
        D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check floor]
        D3 -->|Gaps| D4[Ask questions or state assumptions]
        D4 --> D3
        D3 -->|Passes| D5[Compress prompt]
        D5 --> D6{Cut removed specification?}
        D6 -->|Yes| D7[Revert decorative or destructive cut]
        D7 --> D5
        D6 -->|No| D8{Two empty cuts?}
        D8 -->|No| D9{Floor still passes?}
        D9 -->|No| D10[Return last passing version]
        D10 --> D11[Output contract]
        D9 -->|Yes| D5
        D8 -->|Yes| D11
    end

    D11 --> E["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]
    E -->|Keep negotiating| D5
    E -->|Human freezes| F{Execution tools available?}
    F -->|No| G[Gate stays closed]
    F -->|Yes| H["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    H --> I{Result}
    I -->|Success| J[Done]
    I -->|Floor failure| K["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    K --> D5
```
